cost_view_rule: One material run emits both 1x and 2x central-cost views from the same target and fill path; doubled cost is never a second trial.
read_discipline: Do not read, reinterpret, or use any controlled, neighboring, diagnostic, or private result to compensate for a failed no-control persistence reference.

registration_prerequisite.condition: Serialized synthetic and organizer validation passes; independent review approves the exact executable set; the new family, A5 executable-source manifest, semantic review, score manifest, source hashes, trial opt-in, and A7 package rebind are materialized in their required order.

hard_alpha_minima.sleeve_activity_and_exposure: both sleeves pass every frozen minimum

stages.required_outcome: Every official central-development gate and every stricter no-control role, regime, sleeve, and concentration minimum passes. Any failure is terminal and suppresses the non-material diagnostic as non-decision-relevant.

stages.activation: only after the no-control material result passes the complete official central-development gate plus every stricter PnL, regime, role, fold, quarter, sleeve, and concentration gate
stages.required_outcome: Passing confirms the core and permits a separately documented future stability plan; failure stops Team 06 with no control rescue.

terminal_rule: A failed no-control PnL, regime, role, sleeve, fold, quarter, concentration, coverage, or IC gate rejects the family. No stop, volatility target, drawdown brake, turnover cap, neighbor, diagnostic, or private ticket can compensate.
